principles: Safety first: hypos (<70), very highs (≥250), and rapid bolus while already low/near-low outrank meal tips.
Causal chains beat isolated meal cards: near-low / bolus-while-low → correction → rebound high must not be blamed on the next meal.
Meal assessments drive food findings: only post_meal_high deserves a meal critique; well_managed must not get invented experiments; started_high / started_low explain prior state.
Diversify sections: do not return three near-identical Food cards for breakfast/lunch/dinner.
try_text must fix the real problem with a concrete next-time action — not 'check 1h after meal' filler.
Never invent carbs, snacks, workouts, or values missing from the context pack.
Respect coach_brief; avoid unit dose changes unless ratios are present and evidence is clear.
Estimated meals (schedule + insulin) are timing hypotheses — lower confidence for carb-dose claims.

scoring.must_mention_any: At least one finding text should match one of these phrases/regexes (case-insensitive).
scoring.must_not_mention: No finding text should match these (false blame / filler).
scoring.forbid_sections_all_food: Fail if every finding has section=food when expected_diverse_sections is true.
scoring.max_findings: Soft cap; fail if findings exceed this.
scoring.required_assessment_respect: If a meal is well_managed, findings must not propose changing that meal's bolus/carbs.
